Pointer cast of byte-offset arithmetic reaching a struct member via an array-indexed element + sibling field + offset (e.g. `(CMirror *)(p[1].create_event + 0x1c)` -> `&this->mirror`). Replace with the named field/array access in a .keep.

Ghidra pre-increment-array-walk loop artifact on `pCVar5` (per-iteration advance via struct-field/pointer arithmetic — single-var `pCVar5 = pCVar5;` self-assign or two-var `tmp = &pCVar5->field; pCVar5 = tmp;` ping-pong — plus a constant-index store on `pCVar5`). The stride/sentinel are baked from the original struct layout, so it overruns on any layout change (e.g. the 64-bit port). Always wrong as-decoded; cross-reference .asm and rewrite as a straightforward for-loop in a .keep (watch for the skip-row store-offset bug).
